name: FrameMutationService

test_list.description: Preparation validates the sealed frame/token binding and actual ProposeDiff right over the exact target, diff digest, and observed churn; denial leaves workspace and CAS unchanged.
A create-new request with expected_base None prepares against an absent target; the public base remains None while verifier snapshots use the actual empty old bytes.
Bounded typed write_file, unique or replace-all edit_file, and single-file apply_patch requests produce byte-exact candidates and a single path-bound diff.

An approved actual hybrid-verifier result is committed only while holding the shared write lease and valid OCC ticket; the durable CAS receipt matches the bytes read from the workspace and its diff/evidence identities.
A base changed after prepare, or a target created after a create-new prepare, is rejected before replacing or truncating the workspace file.
A real HybridMutationVerifier NeedsApproval result is durably reported and returns an explicit NeedsApproval error; no file write or approval event occurs.
A token from another issuer/frame, a modified token, or a prepared mutation applied with a different token is rejected without workspace or CAS mutation.
Secret-bearing, .git/.polaris internal, traversal, symlink/reparse-point, and outside-workspace targets fail closed for existing and create-new operations.
Two preparations against the same base cannot both commit: the real shared lease and OCC recheck allow one update and reject the stale second mutation.
Dropping the caller future after blocking application starts does not release its kernel inspection owner or shared lease while filesystem/verifier work is still executing.

If a failure occurs after the atomic workspace replacement but before durable receipt/event publication, the typed error reports the sanitized target and digest of the bytes actually present, without claiming rollback.
create new file keeps absence as base and records actual bytes
create new file records no base and never uses empty file identity
needs approval returns without changing workspace
capability without propose diff is rejected before workspace change
changed base after prepare is rejected without overwrite
edit and patch requests produce and commit exact candidates
traversal secret and git targets are rejected
mutation diff reconstructs exact missing final newline
oversized source is rejected before hashing the candidate
cancellation during verification prevents commit
readonly frame roles cannot construct a mutation service

inputs.name: service
inputs.description: Trusted service pinned to one actual KernelHandle, sealed FrameToolBinding, capability issuer, shared LeaseManager, real MutationSafety assessor, verifier limits and trusted task intent.

inputs.name: token
inputs.description: Actual frame capability; it must match the sealed binding and authorize Right::ProposeDiff over observed facts.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Bounded typed write_file, edit_file or single-file apply_patch request with an expected base Cid or explicit absence.

inputs.name: prepared
inputs.description: Opaque, non-cloneable prepared snapshot binding exact target, base/absence, proposed source, diff, command, frame and token.

output_description: An exact durable CAS receipt for actual committed bytes, returned only after capability authorization, hybrid verification, shared lease/OCC validation, atomic workspace commit, and durable publication. Rejection, NeedsApproval, stale-base, cancellation, and post-write recording failures remain explicit typed outcomes; no approval is synthesized.
